s: The dance sculptures at Ramappa Temple in Palampet were carved according to the principles of which book of dance science?
o: A treatise on dance in the Marga Saili style
A treatise on dance in the Desi style
x:
The Ramappa Temple at Palampet, built during the Kakatiya period, is one of the finest examples of medieval temple architecture and sculpture in India. It is especially famous for its beautifully carved Madanikas (bracket figures) depicting various dance postures. These sculptures closely follow the principles laid down in Nrittaratnavali, a celebrated treatise on dance written by Jayapa Senani, the commander-in-chief of the Kakatiya ruler Ganapatideva. Nrittaratnavali is one of the most important medieval works on Indian dance. It describes both Marga (classical) and Desi (regional) dance traditions, dance postures, hand gestures, movements and performance techniques. The Ramappa sculptures are regarded as a visual representation of the dance forms described in this treatise.
Hence, the correct answer is
Option (2).
